intro: Original research on unmanned aircraft systems, with a bias toward the surfaces that ship insecure and rarely get looked at. Disclosures below are coordinated; the flagship CVEs are credited to me by MITRE.

methodology.name: Acquire & Map
methodology.detail: Open the airframe, find the debug headers, map the onboard services and the RF link.

methodology.name: Extract & Analyze
methodology.detail: Pull firmware, fuzz the control protocol, and look for the auth that should be there and is not.

methodology.name: Prove & Disclose
methodology.detail: Build a minimal proof, write the teardown, and disclose to the vendor before publishing.

methodology.name: Help Defenders
methodology.detail: Convert each finding into a detection signature so the result is useful to blue teams, not just attackers.
